sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: I'm still getting harassed from time to time by someone trying to break in here, but I think we've come up with a solution if it doesn't cost too much.
sentences.zh: 我时不时还会受到骚扰，有人试图闯入这里，但我想如果我们能找到一个不太贵的解决方案，应该就能解决问题。

sentences.en: Gord is going to wire in a sensor for me, so hopefully we'll know when someone enters the backyard.
sentences.zh: 戈德打算帮我安装一个传感器，这样如果有人进入后院，我们希望能及时察觉。

sentences.en: And we can quietly call the police while he is busy doing his thing.
sentences.zh: 趁他忙着作案的时候，我们可以悄悄报警。

sentences.en: I'm really hopeful we might actually catch him soon.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望能尽快抓住他。

sentences.en: Wouldn't that be wonderful?
sentences.zh: 那该多好啊？

sentences.en: I could actually start living a normal life again.
sentences.zh: 我就能真正开始过上正常的生活了。

sentences.en: I've almost forgotten what that feels like.
sentences.zh: 我几乎都快忘了那种感觉是什么样的了。

sentences.en: The police have been pretty useless, so it would be wonderful to hand him over on a silver platter.
sentences.zh: 警察一直没什么用，所以如果能亲手把他送进监狱，那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, I must bathe and get ready for Marion to pick me up.
sentences.zh: 好了，我得去洗个澡，准备迎接玛丽恩来接我。

sentences.en: Hope to hear from you soon.
sentences.zh: 希望能尽快收到你的消息。

sentences.en: Love, Cindy
sentences.zh: 爱你的，辛迪

sentences.en: 38-year-old Cindy Makepeace was chain-smoking Cameo menthol cigarettes at her dining room table.
sentences.zh: 38岁的辛迪·梅克皮斯正坐在餐桌旁，一根接一根地抽着卡梅奥薄荷味香烟。

sentences.en: It was October 12, 1982, and she had just received her eighth threatening phone call in five days.
sentences.zh: 那是1982年10月12日，她刚刚接到了五天内的第八个威胁电话。

sentences.en: During most calls, nothing could be heard on the other line other than heavy breathing.
sentences.zh: 在大多数电话中，听筒那头除了沉重的呼吸声，什么也听不见。

sentences.en: Other times, a man spoke to her in a menacing whisper.
sentences.zh: 有时，一个男人会用威胁的低语对她说话。

sentences.en: He had made crude sexual suggestions to Cindy a few days prior, but she hung up in disgust before hearing him out.
sentences.zh: 几天前，他曾对辛迪进行过粗俗的性骚扰，但辛迪还没听完就厌恶地挂断了电话。

sentences.en: As night fell, Cindy went around her multi-level stuccoed home in Vancouver, Canada, closing the window drapes.
sentences.zh: 夜幕降临，辛迪在加拿大温哥华那栋多层灰泥住宅里走动，拉上了窗帘。

sentences.en: Ten minutes later, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，电话响了。

sentences.en: The familiar, low, growling voice said,
sentences.zh: 那个熟悉、低沉、咆哮般的声音说道：

sentences.en: Don't think pulling the drapes means I don't know you're in there.
sentences.zh: “别以为拉上窗帘我就不知道你在里面。”

sentences.en: Cindy called the police.
sentences.zh: 辛迪报了警。

sentences.en: An officer arrived and found no sign of the caller lurking outside the house.
sentences.zh: 一名警官赶到现场，但没有发现屋外有任何潜伏者的踪迹。

sentences.en: He couldn't do anything except suggest Cindy make a list of all the calls she received and to get an unlisted phone number.
sentences.zh: 他无能为力，只能建议辛迪把接到的所有电话列个清单，并申请一个不公开的电话号码。

sentences.en: With no known enemies, the highly respected paediatric mental health nurse was at a loss as to who could be harassing her.
sentences.zh: 作为一名备受尊敬的儿科心理健康护士，辛迪没有任何已知的敌人，她完全不知道是谁在骚扰她。

sentences.en: One week later, Cindy returned home with friend Agnes Woodcock after a night out to find that someone had gained entry into her house.
sentences.zh: 一周后，辛迪和朋友艾格尼丝·伍德科克外出归来，发现有人闯入了她的家。

sentences.en: She raced next door and asked her neighbour, who was aware of the calls Cindy had been getting, to investigate.
sentences.zh: 她冲到隔壁，请邻居帮忙查看，邻居也知道辛迪一直受到骚扰的事。

sentences.en: He entered the house ahead of Cindy and Agnes to make sure that the intruder was no longer inside.
sentences.zh: 他走在辛迪和艾格尼丝前面进入屋内，以确保入侵者已经离开。

sentences.en: After a thorough search of all the rooms, the neighbour told the women that it was safe to go in.
sentences.zh: 在彻底搜查了所有房间后，邻居告诉她们可以安全进屋了。

sentences.en: Cindy began to get ready for bed.
sentences.zh: 辛迪开始准备睡觉。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, Agnes heard Cindy screaming.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，艾格尼丝听到了辛迪的尖叫声。

sentences.en: She found Cindy in her bedroom, sobbing and clutching a pillow.
sentences.zh: 她发现辛迪在卧室里，正啜泣着紧紧抓着一个枕头。

sentences.en: The pillow, concealed under the covers of the bed, had been slashed to pieces.
sentences.zh: 那个藏在被子下的枕头已经被割得支离破碎。

sentences.en: The cuts were precise and were carried out with a sharp object, like a razor.
sentences.zh: 切口非常精准，是用剃须刀之类的锋利物体造成的。

sentences.en: Constable Pat McBride of the Vancouver Police responded to Cindy's call.
sentences.zh: 温哥华警局的帕特·麦克布莱德警员接手了辛迪的报案。

sentences.en: As nothing had been stolen from the house, McBride thought that someone was trying to send Cindy a message.
sentences.zh: 由于屋内没有东西被盗，麦克布莱德认为有人是在试图给辛迪传达某种信息。

sentences.en: Even though Cindy had changed her number, the threatening calls continued.
sentences.zh: 尽管辛迪换了号码，威胁电话依然不断。

sentences.en: They were mainly no-talk calls.
sentences.zh: 它们大多是那种不说话的骚扰电话。

sentences.en: Seeking comfort, Cindy contacted her husband.
sentences.zh: 为了寻求安慰，辛迪联系了她的丈夫。

sentences.en: Cindy Hack had met psychiatrist Dr Roy Makepeace at Vancouver General Hospital in the fall of 1965.
sentences.zh: 辛迪·哈克于1965年秋天在温哥华总医院结识了精神科医生罗伊·梅克皮斯。

sentences.en: A natural beauty with long blonde hair, blue eyes and wide smile, Cindy would turn heads wherever she went.
sentences.zh: 辛迪天生丽质，留着长长的金发，有着蓝色的眼睛和灿烂的笑容，走到哪里都会引人注目。

sentences.en: She quickly caught the attention of Roy, who was assisting Cindy with a group project for her nursing studies.
sentences.zh: 她很快吸引了罗伊的注意，当时罗伊正在协助辛迪完成一项护理专业的课题小组作业。

sentences.en: The two became inseparable.
sentences.zh: 两人变得形影不离。

sentences.en: In December 1966, Roy, who was 18 years older, left his wife and two children and married 22-year-old Cindy.
sentences.zh: 1966年12月，比辛迪大18岁的罗伊抛弃了妻子和两个孩子，与22岁的辛迪结婚了。

sentences.en: The union was eventually accepted by Cindy's parents, Otto and Tilly Hack.
sentences.zh: 这段婚姻最终得到了辛迪父母奥托和蒂莉·哈克的认可。

sentences.en: Roy soon became welcomed into the Hack family life, often playing cards and sharing a drink with Cindy's father, who was only six years his senior.
sentences.zh: 罗伊很快融入了哈克一家的生活，经常和只比他大六岁的辛迪父亲一起打牌、喝酒。

sentences.en: The first few years of marriage were an extremely happy time for the newlyweds.
sentences.zh: 婚后的头几年，这对新婚夫妇过得非常幸福。

sentences.en: Cindy, who always dreamed of working with children, was employed at the Children's Foundation,
sentences.zh: 辛迪一直梦想着与孩子们一起工作，她在儿童基金会任职，

sentences.en: a job where she cared for children suffering from trauma and mental health conditions.
sentences.zh: 那份工作让她能够照顾那些遭受创伤和患有心理健康疾病的孩子们。

sentences.en: In 1974, Cindy landed her dream job as the founding director for Blenheim House, a new centre for preschool children requiring mental health support.
sentences.zh: 1974年，辛迪得到了她梦寐以求的工作，担任布伦海姆之家的创始主任，这是一个为需要心理健康支持的学龄前儿童设立的新中心。

sentences.en: Described as gentle and kind, but firm when she needed to be, Cindy ran the centre with utmost professionalism and passion.
sentences.zh: 人们形容辛迪温柔善良，但在需要时又很坚定，她以极高的专业素养和热情经营着这个中心。

sentences.en: In contrast, Roy make-piece was not fairing as well.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，罗伊·梅克皮斯的情况就不那么顺利了。

sentences.en: Although a registered psychiatrist elsewhere, when Roy moved to British Columbia, he failed the accreditation process three times and was not permitted to practice psychiatry.
sentences.zh: 虽然他在别处是注册精神科医生，但罗伊搬到不列颠哥伦比亚省后，三次认证考试均未通过，因此不被允许从事精神病学工作。

sentences.en: Instead, Roy took a job as the head of medical services at BC Hydro, the British Columbian electric utility.
sentences.zh: 于是，罗伊在不列颠哥伦比亚省水电局担任医疗服务主管。

sentences.en: According to Cindy, the disappointment of failing the exams left Roy depressed and he became short-tempered and irritable.
sentences.zh: 据辛迪说，考试失败的挫折让罗伊陷入了抑郁，变得脾气暴躁、易怒。

sentences.en: Roy was a keen sailor and fisherman.
sentences.zh: 罗伊是一个热衷于航海和钓鱼的人。

sentences.en: In 1977, he bought a nine-metre catamaran he named The Peacemaker.
sentences.zh: 1977年，他买了一艘9米长的双体船，取名为“和事佬号”。

sentences.en: Cindy accompanied him on some of his voyages.
sentences.zh: 辛迪曾陪他出海过几次。

sentences.en: But the trips were unpleasant, as Cindy had a severe phobia of water.
sentences.zh: 但这些旅行并不愉快，因为辛迪有严重的恐水症。

sentences.en: Her fear was so great that she couldn't even get into a swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 她的恐惧程度之深，甚至连游泳池都不敢进。

sentences.en: When sailing in Roy's boat, Cindy would spend the majority of her time under the deck with her dog, Heidi.
sentences.zh: 在罗伊的船上航行时，辛迪大部分时间都和她的狗海蒂躲在甲板下。

sentences.en: Cindy's lack of interest in Roy's maritime activities drove a wedge between the couple.
sentences.zh: 辛迪对罗伊的海上活动缺乏兴趣，这在夫妻之间造成了隔阂。

sentences.en: Cindy preferred tending to her garden, which became a sanctuary where she could escape her marital troubles.
sentences.zh: 辛迪更喜欢打理她的花园，那里成了她逃避婚姻烦恼的避风港。

sentences.en: Cindy and Roy drifted apart over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，辛迪和罗伊渐行渐远。

sentences.en: On July 1, 1982, after 16 years of marriage, the couple separated amicably.
sentences.zh: 1982年7月1日，在结婚16年后，两人友好地分居了。

sentences.en: They lived in different houses, but would continue to see each other for the occasional dinner date or trip to the symphony, a pastime they both enjoyed.
sentences.zh: 他们住在不同的房子里，但仍会偶尔一起吃晚餐或去听交响乐，这是他们共同的爱好。

sentences.en: Roy stayed in their home, while Cindy rented the main floor of a house in East Vancouver, only 14 blocks from her workplace.
sentences.zh: 罗伊留在了原来的家里，而辛迪租下了东温哥华一栋房子的一楼，离她的工作地点只有14个街区。

sentences.en: Three months later, the harassing phone calls began.
sentences.zh: 三个月后，骚扰电话开始了。

sentences.en: Sitting on Cindy's bed, Roy Makepeace examined the slashed pillow.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯坐在辛迪的床上，检查着那个被割烂的枕头。

sentences.en: He tried to reassure Cindy, who was still very upset about the incident.
sentences.zh: 他试图安慰辛迪，她对这件事仍然感到非常不安。

sentences.en: As Roy left that evening, he took the pillow with him and threw it away.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上罗伊离开时，带走了那个枕头并把它扔掉了。

sentences.en: The following day, the tenants who rented the apartment underneath Cindy's phoned the local police.
sentences.zh: 第二天，住在辛迪楼下的租客给当地警方打了电话。

sentences.en: They knew Cindy had left for work, however, they could hear noises coming from her place above.
sentences.zh: 他们知道辛迪已经去上班了，但他们能听到楼上她的住处传来响动。

sentences.en: Officers arrived, but it appeared as though the intruder had come and gone without a trace.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到现场，但入侵者似乎已经悄无声息地离开了。

sentences.en: A few days later, Constable Pat McBride, who had been dispatched to Cindy's house on the night of the slashed pillow attack, returned to her home.
sentences.zh: 几天后，在枕头被割烂那晚曾出警的帕特·麦克布莱德警员再次来到辛迪家。

sentences.en: To put her mind at ease, he had with him deadbolts to put on her doors.
sentences.zh: 为了让她安心，他带了门栓来安装在她的门上。

sentences.en: The two became good friends.
sentences.zh: 两人成了好朋友。

sentences.en: McBride had separated from his wife and was looking to stay somewhere for a month while an apartment became available for him.
sentences.zh: 麦克布莱德当时也与妻子分居，正在寻找一个能住一个月的地方，直到有公寓空出来。

sentences.en: Cindy suggested he rent a room in her house, explaining that it benefited them both.
sentences.zh: 辛迪建议他租下她家的一间房，并解释说这对他们双方都有利。

sentences.en: He would have somewhere to live and she would have someone to offer protection.
sentences.zh: 他有了住处，而她也有人可以提供保护。

sentences.en: Constable Pat McBride agreed and moved in on November 1.
sentences.zh: 帕特·麦克布莱德警员同意了，并于11月1日搬了进去。

sentences.en: The no-talk telephone calls continued.
sentences.zh: 那些不说话的骚扰电话仍在继续。

sentences.en: On November 22, Cindy was getting into her car after a day of work when she noticed a note stuck to the windshield.
sentences.zh: 11月22日，辛迪下班后正准备上车，发现挡风玻璃上贴着一张纸条。

sentences.en: An image of a woman who resembled Cindy had been cut from a magazine.
sentences.zh: 那是一张从杂志上剪下来的图片，上面是一个长得像辛迪的女人。

sentences.en: Her eyes had been scratched out by a sharp object.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛被尖锐的物体划破了。

sentences.en: Whoever was stalking Cindy Makepeace knew where she worked.
sentences.zh: 无论谁在跟踪辛迪·梅克皮斯，他都知道她在哪里工作。

sentences.en: Vancouver police increased their patrols around Cindy's house.
sentences.zh: 温哥华警方加强了对辛迪住所周边的巡逻。

sentences.en: On November 28, Officer Pat McBride returned to the property mid-shift to have a coffee with Cindy.
sentences.zh: 11月28日，帕特·麦克布莱德警员在值班中途回到辛迪家喝咖啡。

sentences.en: After he left, he received a call-out advising that Cindy's phone lines had been cut.
sentences.zh: 他离开后，接到了一个出警通知，称辛迪家的电话线被切断了。

sentences.en: They had been cut in five places, however the phone line to the downstairs tenants remained intact.
sentences.zh: 电话线在五个地方被切断了，但通往楼下租客的电话线却完好无损。

sentences.en: Cindy had received a hang-up call half an hour before she realised the lines were dead.
sentences.zh: 在意识到电话线断掉的前半小时，辛迪曾接到过一个挂断电话。

sentences.en: Officer McBride and his partner kept surveillance on the home until their shift finished at 7am, but no further incidents occurred.
sentences.zh: 麦克布莱德警员和他的搭档一直监视着这栋房子，直到早上7点换班，但没有再发生其他事件。

sentences.en: He continued investigating, discovering that a woman two doors down from Cindy had also received hang-up and no-talk phone calls.
sentences.zh: 他继续调查，发现辛迪家隔壁两户的一名女性也接到了挂断和不说话的骚扰电话。

sentences.en: A neighbour told Pat McBride that he had also seen a strange man lurking around Cindy's house on three occasions, but couldn't offer a description.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居告诉帕特·麦克布莱德，他曾三次看到一个陌生的男人在辛迪家附近徘徊，但无法提供具体的体貌特征。

sentences.en: In early December 1982, Officer McBride moved out of Cindy's house.
sentences.zh: 1982年12月初，麦克布莱德警员搬出了辛迪家。

sentences.en: Over the month that they had lived together, Cindy and Pat had formed a bond.
sentences.zh: 在他们同住的一个月里，辛迪和帕特建立了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: The pair began dating, before entering into an intimate relationship.
sentences.zh: 两人开始约会，随后发展成了亲密关系。

sentences.en: At times, they would double date with Roy Makepeace and one of his female friends.
sentences.zh: 有时，他们会和罗伊·梅克皮斯以及他的一位女性朋友一起进行双重约会。

sentences.en: Even though she was living alone again, Cindy assured family and friends that she was fine.
sentences.zh: 尽管又是一个人住，辛迪向家人和朋友保证她很好。

sentences.en: Cindy was resilient, she had endured hardships throughout her life and was not going to let the recent events get to her.
sentences.zh: 辛迪很坚强，她一生中经历过许多磨难，不会让最近发生的事情击垮自己。

sentences.en: Although loved by their parents, growing up, Cindy and her five siblings were disciplined sternly by their Air Force instructor father.
sentences.zh: 虽然深受父母疼爱，但辛迪和她的五个兄弟姐妹在成长过程中，一直受到身为空军教官的父亲严厉的管教。

sentences.en: At age six, Cindy began experiencing nightmares.
sentences.zh: 六岁时，辛迪开始做噩梦。

sentences.en: They continued into her adult years and would cause her to wake screaming.
sentences.zh: 这些噩梦一直持续到她成年，常让她在尖叫中惊醒。

sentences.en: Young Cindy's distress was amplified by her fear of the basement in her family home.
sentences.zh: 年幼的辛迪对家中地下室的恐惧加剧了她的痛苦。

sentences.en: Recalling her childhood to friends, Cindy remembered having to eat in the darkened space because there wasn't enough room for all the Hack family around the dinner table.
sentences.zh: 在向朋友回忆童年时，辛迪记得因为餐桌坐不下哈克一家所有人，她不得不坐在昏暗的地下室里吃饭。

sentences.en: She was also sent down there for misbehaving.
sentences.zh: 她表现不好时也会被关在那里。

sentences.en: Cindy also confided to Roy that she had been sexually assaulted by one of her brothers as a child.
sentences.zh: 辛迪还向罗伊吐露，她小时候曾被其中一个兄弟性侵过。

sentences.en: Being someone who kept things to herself, she chose not to elaborate.
sentences.zh: 作为一个习惯把心事藏在心里的人，她选择不再多说。

sentences.en: Regular changes in postings for Otto meant that the Hack family moved often, but Cindy maintained A grades throughout her schooling.
sentences.zh: 奥托频繁的调职意味着哈克一家经常搬家，但辛迪在整个求学期间一直保持着优异的成绩。

sentences.en: She had dreams of attending college, however Otto was of the opinion that only his sons should attend.
sentences.zh: 她梦想着上大学，但奥托认为只有他的儿子们才应该上大学。

sentences.en: Instead, he permitted Cindy to enrol in nursing school.
sentences.zh: 相反，他允许辛迪报名参加护理学校。

sentences.en: In 1963, Cindy met a resident doctor and the two of them had a brief relationship, ending when he was killed in an accident.
sentences.zh: 1963年，辛迪结识了一位住院医生，两人有过一段短暂的恋情，直到他在一场事故中丧生。

sentences.en: Heartbroken, Cindy threw herself into her studies and came top of her class in the psychiatric components of her course.
sentences.zh: 心碎的辛迪全身心投入到学习中，并在课程的精神病学部分取得了班级第一的成绩。

sentences.en: It was an area she found fascinating.
sentences.zh: 她发现这是一个非常迷人的领域。

sentences.en: In December 1982, police on heightened patrol noted Roy Makepeace's car circling the block of Cindy's residence.
sentences.zh: 1982年12月，加强巡逻的警察注意到罗伊·梅克皮斯的车在辛迪住所所在的街区绕圈。

sentences.en: He drove into the laneway behind her house and turned the headlights off.
sentences.zh: 他开车进入了她家后面的小巷，并关掉了车前灯。

sentences.en: Officers approached Roy, who claimed he was there to protect his wife.
sentences.zh: 警察走近罗伊，他声称自己在那儿是为了保护他的妻子。

sentences.en: They advised him to move on.
sentences.zh: 他们建议他离开。

sentences.en: In the book about Cindy Makepeace by Ian Mulgrew, Cindy told Officer Pat McBride that one night she had awoken to a tapping at her window.
sentences.zh: 在伊恩·马尔格鲁所著关于辛迪·梅克皮斯的书中，辛迪告诉帕特·麦克布莱德警员，有一天晚上她被窗户上的敲击声惊醒。

sentences.en: Terrified, she pulled back the curtain to find Roy there, armed with a knife and a rifle.
sentences.zh: 她惊恐地拉开窗帘，发现罗伊站在那里，手里拿着一把刀和一支步枪。

sentences.en: He told Cindy to sleep easy because he was guarding her premises.
sentences.zh: 他告诉辛迪安心睡觉，因为他在守卫她的住所。

sentences.en: The next day, Roy recounted the night's events to Cindy, explaining his theory that someone from the mafia could be out to get her.
sentences.zh: 第二天，罗伊向辛迪讲述了当晚发生的事情，并解释了他的理论：可能有人想对她不利，甚至可能是黑手党。

sentences.en: He told Cindy that the phone calls, the stalker activity and the slashed pillow were reminiscent of scenes from the crime film The Godfather.
sentences.zh: 他告诉辛迪，那些电话、跟踪行为和被割烂的枕头，让他想起了犯罪电影《教父》中的场景。

sentences.en: Roy thought that Cindy may have upset the family of one of her patients and that they were terrorising her as a way of exacting revenge.
sentences.zh: 罗伊认为辛迪可能得罪了她某位病人的家人，他们正在通过恐吓她来实施报复。

sentences.en: He warned Cindy not to use the downstairs laundry room as someone could easily slip in there and slit her throat, remarking that she wouldn't be found for days.
sentences.zh: 他警告辛迪不要使用楼下的洗衣房，因为有人可以轻易溜进去割断她的喉咙，并说她可能几天都不会被发现。

sentences.en: Roy asked Cindy to move back in with him and was angered when she refused.
sentences.zh: 罗伊要求辛迪搬回去和他住，当她拒绝时，他感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: In late December, Roy went with Cindy to her parents' place on Vancouver Island for the holidays.
sentences.zh: 12月下旬，罗伊陪辛迪去温哥华岛的父母家过节。

sentences.en: The pair exchanged gifts like old times, although it was obvious that their relationship was strained.
sentences.zh: 两人像往常一样交换了礼物，尽管很明显他们的关系已经非常紧张。

sentences.en: On January 15 the following year, Officer Pat McBride was visiting Cindy when she received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 次年1月15日，帕特·麦克布莱德警员正在拜访辛迪时，她接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: McBride listened in.
sentences.zh: 麦克布莱德在旁边听着。

sentences.en: There was no voice on the other line.
sentences.zh: 听筒那头没有任何声音。

sentences.en: However, a woman's voice over a PA system was audible in the background.
sentences.zh: 然而，背景中可以听到公共广播系统里传来一个女人的声音。

sentences.en: It sounded like the call was coming from an airport.
sentences.zh: 听起来电话像是从机场打来的。

sentences.en: A wiretap had been placed on Cindy's phone, though the caller didn't stay on the line long enough for a full trace.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的电话被安装了窃听器，但通话时间太短，无法进行完整追踪。

sentences.en: But a partial trace placed the call as coming from the Richmond area, the location of Vancouver Airport.
sentences.zh: 不过，部分追踪结果显示电话来自列治文地区，也就是温哥华机场的所在地。

sentences.en: On the night of January 27, Cindy was feeling particularly anxious.
sentences.zh: 1月27日晚上，辛迪感到特别焦虑。

sentences.en: Her friend, Agnes Woodcock, told Cindy that she would stay the night so she had someone else in the house with her.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友艾格尼丝·伍德科克告诉辛迪，她会留下来过夜，这样家里就有其他人陪着她了。

sentences.en: Cindy gratefully accepted the offer.
sentences.zh: 辛迪感激地接受了这个提议。

sentences.en: While she waited for Agnes to arrive, Cindy decided to move some old boxes into the garage.
sentences.zh: 在等待艾格尼丝到达时，辛迪决定把一些旧箱子搬到车库里。

sentences.en: As she went to turn on the garage light, she realised it wasn't working.
sentences.zh: 当她去开车库灯时，发现灯坏了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, someone grabbed Cindy by her right arm and told her to keep quiet.
sentences.zh: 突然，有人抓住了辛迪的右臂，叫她保持安静。

sentences.en: Cindy felt a pinprick on her right shoulder and although she tried to fight off her assailant, soon became drowsy.
sentences.zh: 辛迪感到右肩被针扎了一下，尽管她试图反抗袭击者，但很快就变得昏昏欲睡。

sentences.en: The man held a knife and threatened to cut her face if she cried out.
sentences.zh: 那个男人拿着一把刀，威胁说如果她敢尖叫就割开她的脸。

sentences.en: She felt something tight being wrapped around her neck and tried to get a glimpse of her attacker as she struggled to breathe.
sentences.zh: 她感觉到有什么紧紧的东西缠在脖子上，在挣扎着呼吸时，她试图看清袭击者的样子。

sentences.en: He was wearing tight gloves and running shoes, but in the darkness, all his features were hidden.
sentences.zh: 他戴着紧身手套，穿着跑鞋，但在黑暗中，他所有的面部特征都被遮住了。

sentences.en: The man went to leave and as he closed the garage door, said to Cindy,
sentences.zh: 那男人准备离开，当他关上车库门时，对辛迪说：

sentences.en: It will take a long time to die.
sentences.zh: 死亡的过程会很漫长。

sentences.en: Agnes arrived at 9.30pm and heard a moaning sound coming from the basement stairwell.
sentences.zh: 艾格尼丝在晚上9点30分到达，听到地下室楼梯间传来呻吟声。

sentences.en: She found Cindy, with a black stocking wrapped tightly around her neck and numerous cuts on her body.
sentences.zh: 她发现了辛迪，脖子上紧紧缠着一只黑色长筒袜，身上有多处伤口。

sentences.en: Cindy was taken to Vancouver General Hospital where she was treated for 14 cuts to her back, shoulders and legs.
sentences.zh: 辛迪被送往温哥华综合医院，在那里她因背部、肩部和腿部的14处伤口接受了治疗。

sentences.en: The emergency doctor thought they had been caused by a razor or scalpel, given the neatness of the incisions.
sentences.zh: 急诊医生认为，鉴于切口非常整齐，这些伤口是由剃须刀或手术刀造成的。

sentences.en: She also had a strangulation mark around her neck caused by the stocking, bruises to her face and what appeared to be a puncture mark from a needle on her right arm.
sentences.zh: 她的脖子上还有长筒袜留下的勒痕，脸上有淤青，右臂上似乎还有一个针孔。

sentences.en: Cindy was hazy about the events.
sentences.zh: 辛迪对当时发生的事情记忆模糊。

sentences.en: She did her best to recount what happened to her to the doctor and to Detective David Boyer-Smith, who was assigned to the investigation.
sentences.zh: 她尽力向医生和负责此案的侦探大卫·博耶-史密斯讲述了发生在她身上的事情。

sentences.en: Roy Makepeace was considered the prime suspect in Cindy's attack.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯被认为是袭击辛迪的主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: He gave an alibi for the night, explaining that he had worked late until about nine, before getting some dinner at a restaurant a few kilometres from Cindy's house.
sentences.zh: 他提供了案发当晚的不在场证明，解释说他一直工作到九点左右，然后去离辛迪家几公里外的一家餐馆吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: He then said he got home after ten, remembering that the late news had already started on television.
sentences.zh: 他说他十点多才到家，记得当时电视上的深夜新闻已经开始了。

sentences.en: Roy agreed to take a polygraph test to confirm his alibi, but it never went ahead.
sentences.zh: 罗伊同意接受测谎仪测试以证实他的不在场证明，但测试最终没有进行。

sentences.en: Medications that Roy took for a heart problem could result in false positives and the stress of the test could trigger his condition.
sentences.zh: 罗伊因心脏问题服用的药物可能会导致假阳性结果，而测试带来的压力可能会诱发他的病情。

sentences.en: Roy Makepeace was free to leave.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯获准离开。

sentences.en: Following the assault, Cindy moved into a bungalow-style house closer to her workplace.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后，辛迪搬进了一栋离工作地点更近的平房式住宅。

sentences.en: Franz thought Cindy would be safer in an apartment building with secure access, but Cindy turned down the idea.
sentences.zh: 弗朗茨认为辛迪住在有安保措施的公寓楼里会更安全，但辛迪拒绝了这个想法。

sentences.en: She wanted a garden to tend to and space for her dog Heidi to run around.
sentences.zh: 她想要一个可以打理的花园，还要有空间让她的狗海蒂跑来跑去。

sentences.en: Cindy refused to divulge much information about the attack to family and Franz, not wanting to burden them with her troubles.
sentences.zh: 辛迪拒绝向家人和弗朗茨透露太多关于袭击的细节，不想让他们为自己的烦恼而操心。

sentences.en: An intensely private person, Cindy felt the attack was hers to deal with on her own.
sentences.zh: 辛迪是一个极其注重隐私的人，她觉得这次袭击是她自己必须面对的事情。

sentences.en: However, as a last resort, Cindy began seeing GP Dr. Alan Connolly to discuss her probleMs.
sentences.zh: 然而，作为最后的手段，辛迪开始去看全科医生艾伦·康诺利，讨论她的问题。

sentences.en: She declined seeing a psychiatrist because she didn't want the stigma attached to seeking professional help.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝去看精神科医生，因为她不想背负寻求专业帮助带来的污名。

sentences.en: Cindy confided to Connolly that she thought she would never feel safe walking down the street again.
sentences.zh: 辛迪向康诺利吐露，她觉得以后再也不敢走在街上了。

sentences.en: Soon, Dr. Connolly began seeing Cindy in her home and stopped charging for visits.
sentences.zh: 很快，康诺利医生开始上门为辛迪看病，并停止了收费。

sentences.en: He became more of a friend than a doctor, even though he continued prescribing her medications for anxiety and to help her sleep.
sentences.zh: 他变得更像是朋友而非医生，尽管他继续为她开抗焦虑和助眠的药物。

sentences.en: Not long after the move, Cindy started receiving letters at work.
sentences.zh: 搬家后不久，辛迪开始在单位收到信件。

sentences.en: Addressed to her, the words and letters were cut from magazines and newspapers.
sentences.zh: 信是写给她的，上面的字和字母都是从杂志和报纸上剪下来的。

sentences.en: The threatening messages inside, such as,
sentences.zh: 里面的威胁信息，例如：

sentences.en: Soon, Cindy, and
sentences.zh: 辛迪，快了，还有

sentences.en: Your Dead Cunt, terrified her, and she promptly tore up the letters and threw them away.
sentences.zh: “你这死婊子”，让她感到恐惧，她立刻把信撕碎扔掉了。

sentences.en: On other occasions, she threw the unopened letters straight into the bin.
sentences.zh: 在其他时候，她会把未拆封的信直接扔进垃圾桶。

sentences.en: On October 15, 1983, Cindy heard Heidi barking outside.
sentences.zh: 1983年10月15日，辛迪听到海蒂在外面叫。

sentences.en: When she went to investigate, she found a dead cat in her yard with a note nearby that read,
sentences.zh: 当她去查看时，发现院子里有一只死猫，旁边有一张纸条写着：

sentences.en: You're next.
sentences.zh: 下一个就是你。

sentences.en: No prints were found on the paper.
sentences.zh: 纸上没有发现指纹。

sentences.en: One month later, Cindy hired private investigator Ozzy Caban at the suggestion of Officer Pat McBride.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，在帕特·麦克布莱德警官的建议下，辛迪聘请了私家侦探奥兹·卡班。

sentences.en: The physical attack on Cindy had been marked inactive due to a lack of leads.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏线索，针对辛迪的身体攻击案已被标记为非活跃状态。

sentences.en: Cindy felt that the Vancouver Police Department wasn't interested in catching her assailant.
sentences.zh: 辛迪觉得温哥华警察局对抓捕袭击者并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: She hoped Ozzy would get her the answers she needed.
sentences.zh: 她希望奥兹能给她想要的答案。

sentences.en: Ozzy gave Cindy a two-way radio with a panic button that she could use in case of emergency, given that Cindy's phone lines had been cut at her new house as well.
sentences.zh: 奥兹给了辛迪一个带有紧急按钮的双向无线电，以备不时之需，因为辛迪新家的电话线也被切断了。

sentences.en: The hang-up calls also continued, now occurring at Cindy's workplace, Blenheim House.
sentences.zh: 骚扰电话也还在继续，现在打到了辛迪的工作地点——布莱尼姆大厦。

sentences.en: Cindy's co-workers were becoming concerned, as the bright and bubbly Cindy now seemed frightened and withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的同事们开始感到担忧，因为曾经开朗活泼的辛迪现在看起来既害怕又退缩。

sentences.en: One day, Cindy awoke to find that her new garden she had put so many hours into had been trampled.
sentences.zh: 一天，辛迪醒来发现她花了那么多时间打理的新花园被践踏了。

sentences.en: Flowers and plants were dug up and strewn around.
sentences.zh: 花草被挖出来，散落得到处都是。

sentences.en: It was reminiscent of a time Roy Makepeace had lost his temper and gone on a similar rampage when they were living together.
sentences.zh: 这让人想起罗伊·梅克皮斯以前和她住在一起时，曾因发脾气而进行过类似的破坏。

sentences.en: Cindy's co-workers discussed the attacks when she wasn't in earshot.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的同事们在她听不见的时候讨论了这些袭击事件。

sentences.en: They recalled when she had come to work in 1981 with a foot and leg injury.
sentences.zh: 他们回想起1981年她来上班时脚和腿受了伤。

sentences.en: She told them that she had injured herself playing racquetball, but later confided to speech pathologist Sue Fisk that Roy had pushed her down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他们是打壁球时受的伤，但后来向言语病理学家苏·菲斯吐露，是罗伊把她推下楼梯的。

sentences.en: Sue also recalled at Christmas that year that Cindy had come to work with a black eye.
sentences.zh: 苏还记得那年圣诞节，辛迪带着黑眼圈来上班。

sentences.en: She walked into Cindy's office later that day to find Roy Makepeace embracing Cindy, saying,
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，她走进辛迪的办公室，发现罗伊·梅克皮斯正拥抱着辛迪，说道：

sentences.en: I'm sorry I did that to you.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我那样对你。

sentences.en: Roy's temper intensified.
sentences.zh: 罗伊的脾气变本加厉。

sentences.en: Cindy confided to another employee that she required reconstructive breast surgery following one particularly violent assault.
sentences.zh: 辛迪向另一名员工吐露，在一次特别暴力的袭击后，她需要进行乳房重建手术。

sentences.en: Her colleagues were relieved in 1982 when Cindy, with another black eye, told them that she and Roy were separating.
sentences.zh: 1982年，当辛迪再次带着黑眼圈告诉同事她和罗伊分手时，同事们都松了一口气。

sentences.en: However, Cindy was adamant that Roy was not responsible for the spate of attacks.
sentences.zh: 然而，辛迪坚称这一连串的袭击不是罗伊所为。

sentences.en: They still went to dinner and dated regularly.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然一起吃晚饭，并定期约会。

sentences.en: Cindy even broke off her relationship with Pat McBride, telling him that things were moving too quickly for her.
sentences.zh: 辛迪甚至结束了与帕特·麦克布莱德的关系，告诉他事情发展得太快了。

sentences.en: On January 30, just before 6pm, Ozzy Caban was informed by his security company that an odd rustling sound was coming from the two-way radio owned by Cindy.
sentences.zh: 1月30日傍晚6点前，奥兹·卡班接到安保公司的通知，称辛迪的双向无线电里传出奇怪的沙沙声。

sentences.en: He made his way to Cindy's house and knocked on the locked door.
sentences.zh: 他赶到辛迪家，敲了敲锁着的门。

sentences.en: When Cindy failed to answer, Ozzy peered through the front window.
sentences.zh: 当辛迪没有回应时，奥兹从前窗往里看。

sentences.en: Scanning the interior, he could make out Cindy lying on her back on the floor of the hallway.
sentences.zh: 扫视室内时，他看到辛迪仰面躺在走廊的地板上。

sentences.en: Her long, blonde hair was covering her face.
sentences.zh: 她那头金色的长发遮住了脸。

sentences.en: After returning to his car to alert the police, Ozzy kicked the front door down and yelled,
sentences.zh: 回到车里报警后，奥兹踢开了前门，大喊道：

sentences.en: Come out, you son of a bitch.
sentences.zh: 滚出来，你这混蛋。

sentences.en: I'll kill you.
sentences.zh: 我要杀了你。

sentences.en: He rushed to Cindy.
sentences.zh: 他冲向辛迪。

sentences.en: She was unconscious, cold and clammy with a visible bump to her head.
sentences.zh: 她昏迷不醒，身体冰冷湿冷，头上有一个明显的肿块。

sentences.en: Her left arm was outstretched and a note was stuck to her left hand, secured in place by a paring knife that pierced her skin and went into the floor below.
sentences.zh: 她的左臂伸展着，左手上粘着一张纸条，被一把刺穿皮肤并扎进地板的削皮刀固定住。

sentences.en: The note, made of letters cut from newspapers and magazines, read,
sentences.zh: 这张由报纸和杂志剪下的字母拼成的纸条上写着：

sentences.en: Now you must die.
sentences.zh: 现在你必须死。

sentences.en: Paramedics arrived and a hospital attendant noticed something hidden in between the skin folds of Cindy's neck.
sentences.zh: 医护人员赶到，一名医院工作人员注意到辛迪脖子的皮肤褶皱里藏着东西。

sentences.en: Tied so tightly it was initially obscured from view, was a black nylon stocking.
sentences.zh: 那是一只黑色的尼龙长筒袜，系得太紧，起初被遮住了。

sentences.en: Scans revealed Cindy had not sustained any brain damage from being strangled and she was released from hospital the next day.
sentences.zh: 扫描显示辛迪没有因勒颈而受到任何脑损伤，她第二天就出院了。

sentences.en: She told the police that she had returned home from work approximately an hour before the attack.
sentences.zh: 她告诉警察，她在袭击发生前大约一小时下班回家。

sentences.en: She was unlocking her back door to let Heidi inside when she saw a man coming through the side gate of her house.
sentences.zh: 她正打开后门让海蒂进去时，看到一个男人从她家的侧门走进来。

sentences.en: Cindy thought it was a neighbour and called out to him.
sentences.zh: 辛迪以为是邻居，便叫了他一声。

sentences.en: But the man remained silent and walked briskly up the stairs to her.
sentences.zh: 但那男人保持沉默，快步走上楼梯向她走来。

sentences.en: Cindy began to panic and was frozen in fear.
sentences.zh: 辛迪开始恐慌，吓得僵住了。

sentences.en: The man struck her over the head with something.
sentences.zh: 那男人用什么东西击中了她的头部。

sentences.en: She couldn't recall the events that followed, other than waking up on the kitchen floor with the impression that there were two men with her.
sentences.zh: 她记不起之后发生的事情，只记得在厨房地板上醒来，感觉当时有两个男人在场。

sentences.en: After they left, Cindy remembered crawling to the hallway to retrieve the two-way radio and trying to contact Ozzy.
sentences.zh: 他们离开后，辛迪记得自己爬到走廊拿回双向无线电，并试图联系奥兹。

sentences.en: Cindy described her main attacker to Ozzy.
sentences.zh: 辛迪向奥兹描述了袭击她的主犯。

sentences.en: He had a brown moustache, blue eyes and was wearing a blue nylon jacket.
sentences.zh: 他留着棕色胡子，蓝眼睛，穿着一件蓝色尼龙夹克。

sentences.en: She confided to Ozzy that she hadn't given the police his description as he had threatened to kill her sisters if she told them anything.
sentences.zh: 她向奥兹吐露，她没有向警方提供他的描述，因为他威胁说如果她敢说出去就杀了她的姐妹。

sentences.en: Despite Ozzy's encouragement, she refused to disclose any information about the attack to authorities other than the basic details.
sentences.zh: 尽管奥兹鼓励她，但她拒绝向当局透露除基本细节外的任何袭击信息。

sentences.en: On February 14, Roy Makepeace was questioned about the incident.
sentences.zh: 2月14日，罗伊·梅克皮斯就此事接受了询问。

sentences.en: Detective David Boyer-Smith believed him to be responsible for the attack.
sentences.zh: 侦探大卫·博耶-史密斯认为他应对这次袭击负责。

sentences.en: In a six-hour interrogation, he continued to barrage Roy in an attempt to get him to crack.
sentences.zh: 在长达六小时的审讯中，他不断向罗伊施压，试图让他崩溃。

sentences.en: He warned Roy that he would be charged with two acts of attempted murder over the two physical assaults.
sentences.zh: 他警告罗伊，他将因这两次身体攻击而被控两项谋杀未遂罪。

sentences.en: After refusing to give in, Detective Boyer-Smith told Roy that Cindy had given him up, finally telling police that she believed he was the perpetrator behind the attacks on her.
sentences.zh: 在罗伊拒绝认罪后，博耶-史密斯侦探告诉罗伊，辛迪已经把他供出来了，最终告诉警方她认为他就是袭击她的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: She had told detectives that he was a violent man and she was terrified of him.
sentences.zh: 她告诉侦探，他是一个暴力的人，她很怕他。

sentences.en: Roy steadfastly denied any involvement, however, admitted to slapping Cindy on two occasions when they were living together.
sentences.zh: 罗伊坚决否认参与其中，但承认在他们住在一起时曾两次扇过辛迪耳光。

sentences.en: He denied ever punching Cindy, giving her black eyes or any of the other incidences of assault she claimed.
sentences.zh: 他否认曾殴打过辛迪、让她眼眶发青或有她声称的其他袭击事件。

sentences.en: Roy maintained his theory that the mafia were involved in the attacks and explained this to the dubious detectives.
sentences.zh: 罗伊坚持认为黑手党参与了这些袭击，并向怀疑他的侦探解释了这一点。

sentences.en: With no evidence to charge him, Roy was allowed to leave the station.
sentences.zh: 由于没有证据起诉他，罗伊获准离开警局。

sentences.en: Cindy recuperated from her ordeal and took a brief holiday to her parents' bungalow on Vancouver Island.
sentences.zh: 辛迪从磨难中恢复过来，去温哥华岛父母的平房度了个短假。

sentences.en: The respite did her good and Cindy returned to work happy and upbeat.
sentences.zh: 这次休养对她很有帮助，辛迪回到工作岗位时心情愉快、充满活力。

sentences.en: Following the previous attack four months prior, Cindy and Ozzie had devised a safety plan.
sentences.zh: 继四个月前的袭击后，辛迪和奥兹制定了一项安全计划。

sentences.en: She would call his firm when she was leaving her house and also when she returned, so that Ozzie knew she was unharmed.
sentences.zh: 她离开家和回家时都会给他的公司打电话，这样奥兹就知道她平安无事。

sentences.en: On July 23, at 8.16pm, Cindy phoned Ozzie Caban's security company to let them know she was taking Heidi for a quick walk in a nearby park and would return in an hour.
sentences.zh: 7月23日晚上8点16分，辛迪给奥兹·卡班的安保公司打电话，说她要带海蒂去附近的公园散步，一小时后回来。

sentences.en: It was a warm night and Cindy watched the tennis players at the nearby community centre.
sentences.zh: 那是一个温暖的夜晚，辛迪看着附近社区中心的网球选手打球。

sentences.en: As she walked along, a green van pulled up alongside her.
sentences.zh: 当她走着的时候，一辆绿色货车停在她身边。

sentences.en: Its driver was a man with long dark hair, a bushy beard and wearing square horn-rimmed glasses.
sentences.zh: 司机是一个留着深色长发、浓密胡须、戴着方形黑框眼镜的男人。

sentences.en: He spoke to her through the open passenger window while leaning across a blonde-haired female in the passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 他探过身子，越过副驾驶座上一名金发女子，通过打开的车窗对她说话。

sentences.en: He asked,
sentences.zh: 他问道：

sentences.en: Excuse me ma'am, do you know where Churchill Street is?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，女士，你知道丘吉尔街在哪里吗？

sentences.en: Cindy started to give directions.
sentences.zh: 辛迪开始为他指路。

sentences.en: Approximately three hours later, Regan Trethway heard a strange noise.
sentences.zh: 大约三小时后，里根·特雷斯韦听到了奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: He looked out the front window of his house and saw a blonde woman trying to open his front door.
sentences.zh: 他向自家前窗看去，看到一个金发女子正试图打开他的前门。

sentences.en: It was Cindy Makepeace.
sentences.zh: 那是辛迪·梅克皮斯。

sentences.en: She mouthed some words to him and was about to lose consciousness.
sentences.zh: 她对他动了动嘴唇，眼看就要失去知觉。

sentences.en: As she pointed to her throat, Regan could make out a black stocking tied tightly around her neck.
sentences.zh: 当她指向自己的喉咙时，里根看到她脖子上紧紧缠着一只黑色长筒袜。

sentences.en: He cut the ligature with difficulty as it was so tight he couldn't get his fingers under it.
sentences.zh: 他费力地割断了勒带，因为它太紧了，手指根本伸不进去。

sentences.en: Treating doctors at the University of BC Hospital Emergency Department did not know what to make of the attack.
sentences.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学医院急诊科的医生们不知道该如何处理这次袭击。

sentences.en: Cindy had puffy red eyes from being strangled, a bloody left nostril, and a sore right ankle.
sentences.zh: 辛迪因被勒颈导致双眼红肿，左鼻孔流血，右脚踝疼痛。

sentences.en: Ozzy Caban had met Cindy at Regan Trethway's before she was transported by ambulance.
sentences.zh: 奥兹·卡班在辛迪被救护车送走前，在里根·特雷斯韦家见到了她。

sentences.en: He informed the doctors of two fresh needle puncture marks he had seen on Cindy's inner elbow.
sentences.zh: 他告诉医生，他在辛迪的手肘内侧看到了两个新鲜的针孔。

sentences.en: Toxicology tests were run which showed the presence of benzodiazepines in Cindy's bloodstream, but did not give a result as to the concentration of drugs in her system.
sentences.zh: 毒理学测试显示辛迪血液中存在苯二氮卓类药物，但未能得出药物浓度的结果。

sentences.en: When they undressed her, nursing staff found twigs and leaves in her underwear.
sentences.zh: 当护士为她脱衣服时，在她的内衣里发现了树枝和树叶。

sentences.en: Cindy's recollection of events was hazy.
sentences.zh: 辛迪对事件的记忆很模糊。

sentences.en: She didn't remember anything after giving the man in the van directions.
sentences.zh: 她不记得给货车里的男人指路之后发生的任何事情。

sentences.en: The next thing she recalled was speaking to a doctor in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 她记得的下一件事就是和医院的医生说话。

sentences.en: A search of Dunbar Park where Cindy was abducted located one of her shoes, the canister of dog repellent she carried for protection,
sentences.zh: 对辛迪被绑架的邓巴公园进行搜查时，发现了她的一只鞋、她随身携带用于防身的驱狗喷雾罐，

sentences.en: and a drag mark in the dirt about 10 metres from the sidewalk where the van pulled up.
sentences.zh: 以及距离货车停靠的人行道约10米处的泥地上有一道拖拽痕迹。

sentences.en: Later that evening, in the emergency department, clerk Lisa Lattimore received a call.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，在急诊室，职员丽莎·拉蒂莫尔接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: The call was received directly at the emergency desk, bypassing the hospital's switchboard system.
sentences.zh: 这个电话是直接打到急诊台的，绕过了医院的总机系统。

sentences.en: A man on the line asked,
sentences.zh: 电话那头的男人问道：

sentences.en: Do you have hospital security?
sentences.zh: 你们有医院安保吗？

sentences.en: When Lisa asked him to clarify what he meant, the man replied,
sentences.zh: 当丽莎让他澄清意思时，男人回答：

sentences.en: Do you have security guards?
sentences.zh: 你们有保安吗？

sentences.en: He also asked what time the emergency department closed.
sentences.zh: 他还问急诊室几点关门。

sentences.en: The perplexed clerk advised the man that it didn't close.
sentences.zh: 困惑的职员告诉那个男人，急诊室是不关门的。

sentences.en: He went on to ask how many floors the hospital had.
sentences.zh: 他接着问医院有几层楼。

sentences.en: Not wanting to divulge any further information,
sentences.zh: 不想透露更多信息，

sentences.en: Lisa told the man she would transfer him to her supervisor.
sentences.zh: 丽莎告诉那个男人，她会把他转接给主管。

sentences.en: The man abruptly hung up.
sentences.zh: 男人突然挂断了电话。

sentences.en: Lisa reported the unusual call to Detective David Boyer-Smith, who was at the hospital interviewing Cindy Makepeace.
sentences.zh: 丽莎向正在医院采访辛迪·梅克皮斯的大卫·博耶-史密斯侦探报告了这通异常电话。

sentences.en: She told him that the caller had a strange accent, possibly of South African or New Zealand extraction.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，打电话的人口音很奇怪，可能是南非或新西兰口音。

sentences.en: In an attempt to remember details of the past attacks,
sentences.zh: 为了回忆起过去袭击的细节，

sentences.en: Cindy agreed to undergo sessions of hypnosis.
sentences.zh: 辛迪同意接受催眠治疗。

sentences.en: In the book about Cindy Makepeace by Neil Hall, the sessions were successful.
sentences.zh: 在尼尔·霍尔所著关于辛迪·梅克皮斯的书中，这些治疗是成功的。

sentences.en: Cindy was able to recall from the latest attack the model of the van, that it had chrome mirrors, a rubber pad on the bumper, and a smoky coloured air vent on top.
sentences.zh: 辛迪能够从最近的一次袭击中回忆起货车的型号，它有镀铬后视镜、保险杠上的橡胶垫，以及顶部有一个烟色的通风口。

sentences.en: She recalled being dragged into the van, which had carpeting in the back and several people inside.
sentences.zh: 她回忆起自己被拖进货车，车后部铺着地毯，里面有几个人。

sentences.en: One had a mask and wig on.
sentences.zh: 其中一人戴着面具和假发。

sentences.en: She felt a sharp prick on her arm and voices surrounding her.
sentences.zh: 她感到手臂一阵刺痛，周围都是声音。

sentences.en: One of the voices uttered the word,
sentences.zh: 其中一个声音说了一个词：

sentences.en: Cindy explained that this was a South African Zulu word that translated to, be warned, do as I say.
sentences.zh: 辛迪解释说这是一个南非祖鲁语单词，翻译过来是：小心，照我说的做。

sentences.en: Roy Makepeace was South African and spoke with a strong accent.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯是南非人，说话带有浓重的口音。

sentences.en: At the third hypnosis session held on October 2,
sentences.zh: 在10月2日举行的第三次催眠治疗中，

sentences.en: Cindy made a startling revelation.
sentences.zh: 辛迪透露了一个惊人的消息。

sentences.en: She recalled a trip that she and Roy had taken on board the Peacemaker just over three years earlier, in July 1981.
sentences.zh: 她回忆起三年多前，也就是1981年7月，她和罗伊乘坐“和平使者号”帆船出游的那次经历。

sentences.en: They had sailed to an isolated area of the Gulf Islands, approximately 75 kilometres from Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 他们航行到了海湾群岛的一个偏僻地区，距离温哥华大约75公里。

sentences.en: As they tied up to the wharf,
sentences.zh: 当他们把船系在码头上时，

sentences.en: Cindy decided to stay below and take a nap, while Roy went to look at some property on the island.
sentences.zh: 辛迪决定留在船舱里小睡一会儿，而罗伊则去岛上看几处房产。

sentences.en: Becoming visibly distressed during the hypnosis session,
sentences.zh: 在催眠过程中，辛迪显得非常痛苦，

sentences.en: Cindy recounted how she heard some shouting.
sentences.zh: 她讲述了自己如何听到了一些喊叫声。

sentences.en: After putting on her jeans and shoes, she went above deck and shouted back.
sentences.zh: 穿上牛仔裤和鞋子后，她走到甲板上大声回应。

sentences.en: No one responded.
sentences.zh: 没有人回答。

sentences.en: She investigated the noise, happening upon a log cabin further inland at the top of a hill.
sentences.zh: 她循声查看，偶然发现山顶深处有一间原木小屋。

sentences.en: She approached the front porch.
sentences.zh: 她走近前廊。

sentences.en: Firewood was stacked neatly to one side.
sentences.zh: 一侧整齐地堆放着木柴。

sentences.en: Cindy knocked on the door, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 辛迪敲了敲门，但无人应答。

sentences.en: She cautiously opened the door to see Roy Makepeace standing there.
sentences.zh: 她小心翼翼地推开门，看到罗伊·梅克皮斯正站在里面。

sentences.en: He was very angry.
sentences.zh: 他非常愤怒。

sentences.en: On the floor were the bodies of two people, a man in his 30s and a woman in her 20s.
sentences.zh: 地板上躺着两具尸体，一名30多岁的男子和一名20多岁的女子。

sentences.en: Roy was holding a knife.
sentences.zh: 罗伊手里拿着一把刀。

sentences.en: It was covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 刀上沾满了血。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Running from the cabin,
sentences.zh: 从木屋跑出来时，

sentences.en: Cindy screamed out to Roy that he was a murderer and vomited.
sentences.zh: 辛迪尖叫着骂罗伊是杀人犯，随后呕吐不止。

sentences.en: Roy caught up to Cindy, slapped her on the face and shook her.
sentences.zh: 罗伊追上辛迪，打了她一巴掌并摇晃她。

sentences.en: The next thing she remembered was sitting on a bed while Roy hacked the bodies into pieces with an axe to dispose of in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 她接下来的记忆就是坐在床上，看着罗伊用斧头将尸体剁碎，以便抛入海中。

sentences.en: From the book by Neil Hall,
sentences.zh: 摘自尼尔·霍尔的书，

sentences.en: Cindy told the hypnotherapist,
sentences.zh: 辛迪告诉催眠治疗师，

sentences.en: I don't know how I got there.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是怎么到那里的。

sentences.en: I'm just sitting on the bed.
sentences.zh: 我只是坐在床上。

sentences.en: I'm numb as if in a shell.
sentences.zh: 我感觉麻木，就像缩在壳里一样。

sentences.en: But part of me is screaming inside.
sentences.zh: 但内心深处，有一个声音在尖叫。

sentences.en: Detectives attempted to pinpoint the cabin that Cindy had described in her hypnotherapy sessions.
sentences.zh: 侦探们试图定位辛迪在催眠治疗中描述的那间小屋。

sentences.en: It was a difficult task given that Cindy was asleep when they docked and didn't know where the cabin was located in the vast expanse of the Gulf Islands.
sentences.zh: 这是一项艰巨的任务，因为辛迪在船靠岸时正在睡觉，根本不知道小屋在广阔的海湾群岛中位于何处。

sentences.en: Although she could recall the interior with clarity, a rough wooden floor, grey blanket, a wooden cupboard stacked with books, an old table that had writing paper on it,
sentences.zh: 尽管她能清晰地回忆起内部陈设：粗糙的木地板、灰色毯子、堆满书的木柜、一张放着信纸的旧桌子，

sentences.en: a wood stove and maps on the wall, the exterior offered no distinguishing features.
sentences.zh: 还有火炉和墙上的地图，但外观却没有任何显著特征。

sentences.en: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police searched the area described by Cindy for a full day but could not locate the cabin.
sentences.zh: 加拿大皇家骑警在辛迪描述的区域搜寻了一整天，但没能找到那间小屋。

sentences.en: Employing another tactic,
sentences.zh: 采取了另一种策略，

sentences.en: Cindy agreed to call her husband using a phone that was tapped by police.
sentences.zh: 辛迪同意在警方的监听下给丈夫打电话。

sentences.en: On July 2 1985, Roy Makepeace's telephone rang.
sentences.zh: 1985年7月2日，罗伊·梅克皮斯的电话响了。

sentences.en: He was surprised to hear Cindy on the other line.
sentences.zh: 听到电话那头是辛迪，他很惊讶。

sentences.en: They had not spoken since he found out she thought him responsible for the attacks.
sentences.zh: 自从他发现辛迪认为他是袭击事件的幕后黑手后，他们就再没说过话。

sentences.en: She began the conversation.
sentences.zh: 她开始了谈话。

sentences.en: With the help of hypnosis,
sentences.zh: 在催眠的帮助下，

sentences.en: I've been able to remember a lot of why things are happening and what happened four years ago.
sentences.zh: 我已经能够想起很多事情发生的原因，以及四年前发生了什么。

sentences.en: I wanted to talk to you before letting the police know that I now remember everything.
sentences.zh: 在告诉警方我已经想起一切之前，我想先和你谈谈。

sentences.en: Roy listened as Cindy recounted the bodies in the log cabin.
sentences.zh: 罗伊听着辛迪讲述木屋里的尸体。

sentences.en: He sounded shocked and angry when she told him she believed he was responsible for the attacks on her and denied any wrongdoing, telling Cindy he had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 当辛迪告诉他，她相信他是袭击事件的元凶时，他显得既震惊又愤怒，并否认了一切不当行为，告诉辛迪这事与他无关。

sentences.en: As she terminated the call, Cindy said,
sentences.zh: 挂断电话时，辛迪说，

sentences.en: We both know that you have been doing it.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道是你干的。

sentences.en: I'm not going to listen to that garbage anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也不会听那些鬼话了。

sentences.en: Immediately following the call,
sentences.zh: 通话结束后，

sentences.en: Cindy and Roy Makepeace were placed on round-the-clock surveillance.
sentences.zh: 辛迪和罗伊·梅克皮斯立即被置于全天候监视之下。

sentences.en: This was ceased five days later due to the expense and resources required.
sentences.zh: 由于费用和资源消耗巨大，五天后监视停止了。

sentences.en: During this time, Roy made no attempt to contact or harm Cindy.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，罗伊没有试图联系或伤害辛迪。

sentences.en: Six months later, on December 11, Cindy left work on her lunch break and didn't return.
sentences.zh: 六个月后的12月11日，辛迪午休离开公司后就再没回来。

sentences.en: That night, Desiree Elsessa was cycling near the University of British Columbia.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，黛西莉·埃尔塞萨正在不列颠哥伦比亚大学附近骑自行车。

sentences.en: It was freezing cold as she rode along West 16th Avenue.
sentences.zh: 她沿着西16大道骑行，天气冷得刺骨。

sentences.en: The December sun had well and truly set by 6.20 as Desiree came to the intersection of Blanca Street.
sentences.zh: 当黛西莉到达布兰卡街路口时，12月的太阳早已完全落山，时间是6点20分。

sentences.en: She stopped when something caught her eye.
sentences.zh: 她停了下来，因为有什么东西引起了她的注意。

sentences.en: A blonde woman staggered before falling into a ditch across the street.
sentences.zh: 一名金发女子摇摇晃晃，随后跌进了街对面的沟里。

sentences.en: Racing over to her, Desiree noticed the woman had a black stocking wrapped tightly around her neck.
sentences.zh: 黛西莉冲过去，发现那女子的脖子上紧紧缠着一只黑色长筒袜。

sentences.en: She managed to tear the stocking off with her bare hands and called an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 她设法用双手扯掉了长筒袜，并拨打了救护车。

sentences.en: When paramedics arrived, they found Cindy Makepeace standing in the ditch, dazed, with icy cold water up to her thighs.
sentences.zh: 医护人员赶到时，发现辛迪·梅克皮斯正站在沟里，神志恍惚，冰冷刺骨的水没过了她的大腿。

sentences.en: She was wearing regular clothes with the addition of a black rubber industrial glove on her right hand.
sentences.zh: 她穿着普通的衣服，右手戴着一只黑色橡胶工业手套。

sentences.en: One of her feet was bare.
sentences.zh: 她一只脚光着。

sentences.en: The other had on a man's work boot.
sentences.zh: 另一只脚穿着一只男式工作靴。

sentences.en: Concerned about hypothermia, a paramedic coaxed Cindy out of the water and worked on warming her as he took her to the University of BC hospital.
sentences.zh: 出于对低体温症的担忧，一名医护人员将辛迪从水中劝出，并在送往不列颠哥伦比亚大学医院的途中为她保暖。

sentences.en: Cindy had scratches on her upper chest, arms, legs and back that looked like they were caused from fingernails or tree branches.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的上胸部、手臂、腿部和背部有抓痕，看起来像是被指甲或树枝抓伤的。

sentences.en: She had a dark bruise to her forehead.
sentences.zh: 她的前额有一块深色的淤青。

sentences.en: There was a fresh puncture wound to Cindy's right elbow, indicating that she had been drugged.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的右肘有一个新鲜的针孔伤口，表明她被注射了药物。

sentences.en: Blood testing showed the presence of benzodiazepines in her bloodstream.
sentences.zh: 血液检测显示她的血液中含有苯二氮卓类药物。

sentences.en: However, Cindy also told the treating doctor she had taken 6mg of the drug Ativan for anxiety earlier in the day.
sentences.zh: 然而，辛迪也告诉主治医生，她当天早些时候为了缓解焦虑服用过6毫克的阿提万。

sentences.en: As with previous attacks, Cindy couldn't remember what had happened to her, only events before and after.
sentences.zh: 和之前的袭击一样，辛迪记不起发生了什么，只记得事件发生前后的情况。

sentences.en: She recalled leaving Blenheim House for lunch and driving to the chemist to pick up her prescription for Ativan.
sentences.zh: 她记得离开布莱尼姆之家去吃午饭，并开车去药店取阿提万的处方药。

sentences.en: The next thing she recalled was going to the hospital in the ambulance, although she had a vague memory of having her hands tied behind her in an unfamiliar room.
sentences.zh: 她接下来的记忆就是坐在救护车里去医院，尽管她模糊地记得在一个陌生房间里双手被反绑着。

sentences.en: Cindy poured her feelings out in her personal diary.
sentences.zh: 辛迪在个人日记中倾诉了自己的感受。

sentences.en: She wrote,
sentences.zh: 她写道：

sentences.en: I don't know why it bothers me so much that I can still only remember bits and pieces of what happened the last time I was attacked.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我还是只能想起上次遇袭时的一些零碎片段，这让我如此困扰。

sentences.en: I don't know which is worse, remembering or not being able to remember.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是记得好，还是记不得好。

sentences.en: I think it would be better if I had total amnesia about it, although it feels so helpless to know things were done to you and you don't know what they were.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我能彻底失忆可能会更好，尽管知道自己遭遇了某些事却不知道具体是什么，这种感觉太无助了。

sentences.en: Cindy returned to work shortly after the attack, but the experience had a profound effect on her.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后不久，辛迪就回到了工作岗位，但这次经历对她产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: She became further withdrawn and it was obvious to her co-workers that she was no longer coping with the demands of her work.
sentences.zh: 她变得更加孤僻，同事们明显看出她已经无法胜任工作要求了。

sentences.en: She looked exhausted, the dark circles around her eyes accentuated by her pale skin.
sentences.zh: 她看起来精疲力竭，苍白的皮肤衬托出眼周深深的黑眼圈。

sentences.en: Cindy felt she had no choice but to move house again.
sentences.zh: 辛迪觉得别无选择，只能再次搬家。

sentences.en: She relocated from Vancouver to the city of Richmond, 15 kilometres south.
sentences.zh: 她从温哥华搬到了南边15公里的列治文市。

sentences.en: Things settled down and Cindy enjoyed the garden at her new rental house, a modest brown and white timber multi-leveled home.
sentences.zh: 生活平静了下来，辛迪很喜欢她新租房子的花园，那是一栋朴素的棕白相间的木质多层住宅。

sentences.en: Cindy's close friends, Tom and Agnes Woodcock, came over on the night of April 12, 1986, four months after the attack in the park.
sentences.zh: 1986年4月12日晚上，也就是公园遇袭事件四个月后，辛迪的好友汤姆和艾格尼丝·伍德科克来看望她。

sentences.en: They played cards and decided to stay the night, retiring to bed at 11 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 他们玩了牌，决定留宿，于11点上床休息。

sentences.en: At 2am, Tom heard a loud thump coming from downstairs.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点，汤姆听到楼下传来一声巨响。

sentences.en: He was putting on his pants when Cindy knocked on his door.
sentences.zh: 他正穿裤子时，辛迪敲了他的门。

sentences.en: She had heard the same noise and asked Tom if he would go with her to investigate.
sentences.zh: 她也听到了同样的响声，问汤姆是否愿意陪她去查看。

sentences.en: They made their way down the hallway together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起沿着走廊走下去。

sentences.en: As Tom passed the window of the living room, he could see flames coming from the basement below them.
sentences.zh: 当汤姆经过客厅窗户时，他看到楼下的地下室冒出了火焰。

sentences.en: He shouted to his wife Agnes to phone for the fire brigade.
sentences.zh: 他大声叫妻子艾格尼丝报警。

sentences.en: Agnes soon returned, telling Tom that the phone line was dead.
sentences.zh: 艾格尼丝很快回来，告诉汤姆电话线断了。

sentences.en: In response, Tom raced outside to flag down anyone who might be able to help.
sentences.zh: 于是，汤姆冲到外面去拦人求助。

sentences.en: He saw a man in his 30s standing near Cindy's house and called to him, asking the man to phone for assistance.
sentences.zh: 他看到一个30多岁的男人站在辛迪家附近，便向他呼救，请他帮忙报警。

sentences.en: The man didn't reply, instead running down a side street and disappearing into the night.
sentences.zh: 那人没有回答，反而跑进一条小巷，消失在夜色中。

sentences.en: The fire was quickly brought under control and extinguished by the Richmond Fire Department at 2.52am.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点52分，火势被列治文消防局迅速控制并扑灭。

sentences.en: Damage was confined to the basement area and Cindy, her guests and her dog were unharmed.
sentences.zh: 损失仅限于地下室区域，辛迪、她的客人们和她的狗都没有受伤。

sentences.en: An investigation by authorities and a specialist fire investigator could not find any evidence to suggest who might be responsible for the blaze.
sentences.zh: 当局和专业火灾调查员的调查未能找到任何证据来确定纵火者是谁。

sentences.en: Cindy thought Roy Makepeace was to blame.
sentences.zh: 辛迪认为罗伊·梅克皮斯是罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: The fire was a massive setback to Cindy.
sentences.zh: 这场火灾对辛迪来说是一个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: She became increasingly despondent in the weeks that followed.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，她变得越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: The major depression that arose from Cindy, realising that the attacks had followed her to her new place, resulted in a stay at St. Paul's Psychiatric Unit.
sentences.zh: 辛迪意识到袭击者已经追到了她的新住处，由此引发的重度抑郁症导致她住进了圣保罗精神科病房。

sentences.en: Gradually, Cindy's mental health improved and on discharge from the hospital, she finalised her relationship with Roy Makepeace, officially divorcing in June 1986.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，辛迪的心理健康状况有所好转，出院后，她结束了与罗伊·梅克皮斯的关系，并于1986年6月正式离婚。

sentences.en: To mark the end of the marriage, Cindy changed her surname from Makepeace to James.
sentences.zh: 为了标志婚姻的终结，辛迪将姓氏从梅克皮斯改成了詹姆斯。

sentences.en: Rather than returning to her maiden name of Hack,
sentences.zh: 她没有改回婚前的姓氏哈克，

sentences.en: Cindy liked the short, easy-to-remember surname of James, and the new beginning it signified.
sentences.zh: 而是喜欢“詹姆斯”这个简短、易记的姓氏，它象征着新的开始。

sentences.en: In mid-1986, Cindy went to Germany to visit and stay with her brother Roger who worked there.
sentences.zh: 1986年中期，辛迪前往德国探望并在那里工作的哥哥罗杰家小住。

sentences.en: On return, Cindy, who had taken six months of sick leave, felt well enough to go back to work.
sentences.zh: 回来后，休了六个月病假的辛迪觉得身体状况足以重返工作岗位。

sentences.en: She was immediately asked to resign.
sentences.zh: 但她随即被要求辞职。

sentences.en: It had been decided in her absence that she wasn't coping well enough to competently continue as director of Blenheim House.
sentences.zh: 公司在她缺席期间决定，她已无法胜任布莱尼姆之家主管的工作。

sentences.en: The decision devastated Cindy as she lived and breathed her job.
sentences.zh: 这个决定让辛迪深受打击，因为她全身心地投入在这份工作中。

sentences.en: As a parting gesture, Cindy received a payout.
sentences.zh: 作为离职补偿，辛迪收到了一笔赔偿金。

sentences.en: Given that she had worked in her specialist role at Blenheim House for 13 years, the company also provided funds for Cindy to upgrade her nursing skills
sentences.zh: 鉴于她在布莱尼姆之家担任专业职务长达13年，公司还为她提供了提升护理技能的资金，

sentences.en: so she could return to work as a hospital ward nurse.
sentences.zh: 这样她就能以医院病房护士的身份重返职场。

sentences.en: Not long after, she took a job at Richmond General Hospital on a ward for patients who had recently been discharged from the ICU but were not well enough to return home.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，她在列治文总医院找到了一份工作，负责护理那些刚从重症监护室出院但身体状况尚不足以回家的病人。

sentences.en: This job had Cindy returning to shift work and working long hours.
sentences.zh: 这份工作让辛迪重新开始了轮班制，工作时间很长。

sentences.en: She had further difficulty sleeping, relying more on medications such as diazepam and lost weight, often feeling too anxious to eat.
sentences.zh: 她再次出现睡眠困难，不得不更多地依赖地西泮等药物，体重也下降了，经常因为焦虑而吃不下饭。

sentences.en: Her weight plummeted to 44 kilograMs.
sentences.zh: 她的体重骤降至44公斤。

sentences.en: At the behest of her psychiatrist, who saw Cindy fortnightly after her release from the psychiatric hospital,
sentences.zh: 在精神科医生的建议下（医生在辛迪出院后每两周见她一次），

sentences.en: Cindy began keeping a private journal.
sentences.zh: 辛迪开始写私人日记。

sentences.en: The psychiatrist hoped it would help if Cindy recorded everything and reflected on her thoughts.
sentences.zh: 医生希望辛迪记录下一切并反思自己的想法，这会有所帮助。

sentences.en: From the book about Cindy by Neil Hall, one entry dated April 30, 1988, read,
sentences.zh: 摘自尼尔·霍尔关于辛迪的书，1988年4月30日的一篇日记写道：

sentences.en: Got a hang-up call about half an hour after getting home.
sentences.zh: 回家半小时后接到了一个骚扰电话。

sentences.en: Don't know if it's that or what, but I feel kind of jittery.
sentences.zh: 不知道是不是因为这个，但我感觉有点心神不宁。

sentences.en: Hope there aren't any more over the next few days, as that seems to have been a pattern before my house was broken into each time.
sentences.zh: 希望未来几天不要再有这种情况了，因为这似乎是我家每次被闯入前的规律。

sentences.en: Maybe I'll take a taxi to work on Monday night so it doesn't look like the house is empty.
sentences.zh: 也许周一晚上我该打车去上班，这样看起来家里就不会是空着的。

sentences.en: Christ, I'm so sick of this.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我真是受够了。

sentences.en: Cindy used her journal to express her anger towards the various people in her life that had left her in despair.
sentences.zh: 辛迪利用日记表达了她对生活中那些让她陷入绝望的人的愤怒。

sentences.en: Her parents for her strict upbringing,
sentences.zh: 包括管教严厉的父母，

sentences.en: Roy Makepeace for his control over her while they were together, and the Vancouver and Richmond police,
sentences.zh: 在一起时控制欲极强的罗伊·梅克皮斯，以及温哥华和列治文的警方，

sentences.en: who, whilst they assured Cindy they were doing everything to catch her assailant, she felt were brushing her off.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们向辛迪保证正在尽一切努力抓住袭击者，但她觉得他们是在敷衍她。

sentences.en: On October 9, 1988,
Roy Makepeace was sitting in his apartment in Kitsilano, Vancouver,
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯正坐在他位于温哥华基斯兰奴的公寓里，

sentences.en: 15 kilometres north of Cindy's house in Richmond.
sentences.zh: 距离辛迪在列治文的家有15公里远。

sentences.en: Two men approached the main entrance and rang the intercom at the secure apartment building.
sentences.zh: 两名男子走近正门，按响了这栋安保严密的公寓楼的对讲机。

sentences.en: Roy didn't recognise them, so ignored their buzzing.
sentences.zh: 罗伊不认识他们，所以没理会他们的按铃。

sentences.en: Several minutes later, he could hear noises at his apartment door.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，他听到公寓门口有动静。

sentences.en: Roy looked out of the peephole, but couldn't see anyone.
sentences.zh: 罗伊从猫眼往外看，却没看到人。

sentences.en: They were just out of view.
sentences.zh: 他们刚好躲在视野之外。

sentences.en: He soon realised it was the two young men who had been outside moments before, someone else having let them into the building.
sentences.zh: 他很快意识到，这正是刚才在外面那两个年轻人，有人把他们放进了楼里。

sentences.en: Roy heard one say, you go down, I'll wait here until he comes out.
sentences.zh: 罗伊听到其中一人说：“你下去，我在这儿等他出来。”

sentences.en: After staying outside for about an hour, both men left.
sentences.zh: 在外面待了大约一个小时后，两人离开了。

sentences.en: Roy, although distressed by the incident, did not contact the police.
sentences.zh: 罗伊虽然对这件事感到不安，但并没有联系警方。

sentences.en: His treatment by detectives over the attacks on his ex-wife made him distrustful and he wanted as little to do with authorities as possible.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在处理他前妻遇袭事件时对他的态度让他感到不信任，他想尽可能少与当局打交道。

sentences.en: Roy decided instead that from now on, any visitors to his apartment would need to buzz on the intercom using Morse code for the letter R, so Roy knew it was safe to let them in.
sentences.zh: 罗伊决定，从现在起，任何来访者都必须在对讲机上用摩尔斯电码敲出字母“R”，这样罗伊才知道放他们进来是安全的。

sentences.en: Two days after the strange man at his door,
sentences.zh: 在那个陌生男人出现在他门口的两天后，

sentences.en: Roy was checking his answering machine when a 12-second message chilled him.
sentences.zh: 罗伊正在检查他的电话答录机时，一条12秒的留言让他不寒而栗。

sentences.en: A low, snarling voice said,
sentences.zh: 一个低沉、咆哮的声音说道：

sentences.en: Sunday.
sentences.zh: 周日。

sentences.en: Dead.
sentences.zh: 死。

sentences.en: Meet.
sentences.zh: 见面。

sentences.en: Soon.
sentences.zh: 很快。

sentences.en: Roy panicked, thinking it was from the two young men who were at his door the previous Sunday.
sentences.zh: 罗伊惊慌失措，以为这是上周日出现在他门口的那两个年轻人留下的。

sentences.en: He replayed the message.
sentences.zh: 他重放了那条留言。

sentences.en: On the second listen, he realised that the caller wasn't saying Sunday.
sentences.zh: 第二次听的时候，他意识到对方说的并不是“周日”。

sentences.en: They were saying Cindy.
sentences.zh: 他们说的是“辛迪”。

sentences.en: Roy believed that the caller was the person who had been harassing Cindy for the past six years.
sentences.zh: 罗伊认为打电话的人就是过去六年来一直骚扰辛迪的那个人。

sentences.en: The next day, as he checked his answering machine again,
sentences.zh: 第二天，当他再次检查答录机时，

sentences.en: Roy had another message.
sentences.zh: 罗伊又收到了一条留言。

sentences.en: This one, in the same growling tone, said,
sentences.zh: 这一条，还是那种咆哮的语气，说道：

sentences.en: Hey man, more smack, more downers, another grand after we waste the cunt.
sentences.zh: 嘿，伙计，多搞点海洛因，多搞点镇静剂，干掉那个婊子后再给一千块。

sentences.en: No more deal.
sentences.zh: 交易取消。

sentences.en: Roy sent a copy of the threatening messages to his lawyer, believing that he was being framed.
sentences.zh: 罗伊把这些威胁留言的副本寄给了他的律师，他认为自己被人陷害了。

sentences.en: In response,
sentences.zh: 作为回应，

sentences.en: Roy's lawyer told him to forward the tapes to the Vancouver police chief.
sentences.zh: 罗伊的律师让他把录音带转交给温哥华警察局长。

sentences.en: Roy declined and did not tell Cindy about the calls.
sentences.zh: 罗伊拒绝了，也没有把这些电话的事告诉辛迪。

sentences.en: Later that month, on October 26,
sentences.zh: 那年晚些时候，10月26日，

sentences.en: Cindy finished work at 8.30pm after a 13-hour shift.
sentences.zh: 辛迪在结束了13个小时的轮班后，于晚上8点30分下班。

sentences.en: She was due to clock off an hour earlier, but a patient on her ward died and Cindy stayed back to complete the required paperwork.
sentences.zh: 她本该早一个小时下班，但病房里的一名病人去世了，辛迪留下来完成了必要的文书工作。

sentences.en: Extremely saddened and dejected at the loss of her patient,
sentences.zh: 因为病人的离世，她感到极度悲伤和沮丧，

sentences.en: Cindy pulled into her garage and waited with the engine and lights off.
sentences.zh: 辛迪把车开进车库，熄火关灯，坐在车里等待。

sentences.en: This was a habit she had gotten into to make sure everything was quiet and safe at her house before she exited her car.
sentences.zh: 这是她养成的一个习惯，为了确保在下车前家里一切安静且安全。

sentences.en: As Cindy got out, she noticed a man standing at the rear of her blue Chevrolet Citation.
sentences.zh: 当辛迪下车时，她注意到一个男人站在她那辆蓝色雪佛兰Citation轿车的后方。

sentences.en: Wearing a ski mask, the man grabbed Cindy and put a knife to her neck.
sentences.zh: 那人戴着滑雪面罩，一把抓住辛迪，用刀抵住她的脖子。

sentences.en: He said that he would kill her.
sentences.zh: 他说他会杀了她。

sentences.en: It was then that Cindy realised there was another man, his face also concealed by a ski mask.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，辛迪意识到还有另一个男人，他的脸也被滑雪面罩遮住了。

sentences.en: Cindy tried to fight off her attackers, but a needle was pushed into her right arm.
sentences.zh: 辛迪试图反抗袭击者，但有人把一根针扎进了她的右臂。

sentences.en: The silent alarm registered to Cindy James was received approximately two and a half hours later by Aussie Caban Security Company.

sentences.en: In an emotion-filled testimony, Roy broke down when describing their blissful years as newlyweds.
sentences.zh: 在充满情感的证词中，罗伊在描述他们新婚燕尔的幸福岁月时崩溃了。

sentences.en: He denounced Cindy's story of a cabin murder in the Gulf Islands revealed under hypnotherapy as sheer fiction.
sentences.zh: 他斥责辛迪在催眠治疗下透露的所谓“海湾群岛小木屋谋杀案”纯属虚构。

sentences.en: Cindy had failed to disclose that her sister

sentences.en: While admitting to slapping Cindy twice in their marriage, he clarified that Cindy did not require reconstructive breast surgery after a particularly savage assault.
sentences.zh: 虽然他承认在婚姻中曾两次掌掴辛迪，但他澄清说，辛迪在一次特别严重的袭击后并不需要进行乳房重建手术。

sentences.en: She had an elective breast augmentation procedure.
sentences.zh: 她做的是择期乳房增大手术。

sentences.zh: 在尼尔·霍尔（Neil Hall）所著的《辛迪·詹姆斯的死亡》（The Deaths of Cindy

sentences.zh: James）一书中，罗伊·梅克皮斯在解释她去世前几年的情况时，声音中带着一丝痛苦说道：

sentences.zh: 情况从糟糕变得更糟，变得无法挽回，直到死亡。

sentences.en: I did everything possible to be supporting, comforting, sympathetic.
sentences.zh: 我尽了一切可能去支持、安慰和同情她。

sentences.en: She was a quiet person who would hold a lot of things in.
sentences.zh: 她是一个安静的人，会把很多事情藏在心里。

sentences.en: Initially, Roy was of the belief that Cindy was targeted by an unknown perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 起初，罗伊认为辛迪是被一个不知名的人盯上了。

sentences.en: However, as time went on,
sentences.zh: 然而，随着时间的推移，

sentences.zh: 辛迪不断销毁她袭击自己的证据，比如有一次她让罗伊扔掉那个被割破的枕头。

sentences.en: He recalled a time he and

sentences.zh: 辛迪一起回到她家，发现两个安装在离地两米高的泛光灯被人拧下来，摔碎在下面的水泥地上。

sentences.en: Roy suggested to Cindy that they save the broken glass for police to fingerprint, but she insisted the glass be disposed of immediately.
sentences.zh: 罗伊建议辛迪把碎玻璃留给警方提取指纹，但她坚持要立即处理掉玻璃。

sentences.en: Around the same time, she asked Roy if he thought she was losing her mind.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，她问罗伊是否觉得她快疯了。

sentences.en: Roy told the jury that he reassured Cindy she wasn't.
sentences.zh: 罗伊告诉陪审团，他当时安慰辛迪说她没有疯。

sentences.en: In hindsight, he said he wished he had encouraged her to open up by asking,
sentences.zh: 事后看来，他说他希望当时能鼓励她敞开心扉，问她：

sentences.en: What makes you think that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么会这么想？

sentences.en: Roy makepeace clarified some other points that had baffled investigators during the years.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯澄清了多年来困扰调查人员的其他一些疑点。

sentences.en: The word hombagosh that Cindy recalled being said to her in the van during an abduction was actually hombagakle, a Zulu term that meant farewell, take care.
sentences.zh: 辛迪回忆在绑架期间在车里听到的“hombagosh”这个词，实际上是“hombagakle”，这是一个祖鲁语词汇，意思是再见、保重。

sentences.en: He explained that his sister used it often in conversation with
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他的妹妹经常在与
