sentences.zh: 辛迪和其他人交谈时使用这个词，也许这个不寻常的短语已经印在了她的脑海里。

sentences.en: Roy also recalled a time just before they were married when
sentences.zh: 罗伊还回忆起婚前不久，

sentences.en: Cindy read him a letter from her mother.
sentences.zh: 辛迪给他读了一封她母亲写的信。

sentences.en: The letter was written in an aggressive tone.
sentences.zh: 信的语气很咄咄逼人。

sentences.en: It lectured Cindy about her poor choice in marrying a divorced man.
sentences.zh: 信中指责辛迪嫁给一个离过婚的男人是个糟糕的选择。

sentences.en: When Roy asked to look at the letter later, Cindy sheepishly told him that she had written it herself and thrown it out.
sentences.zh: 当罗伊后来要求看这封信时，辛迪羞怯地告诉他，那是她自己写的，而且已经扔掉了。

sentences.en: Looking back, Roy wondered if this odd event was the beginning of
sentences.zh: 回首往事，罗伊怀疑这件奇怪的事情是否就是

sentences.en: Cindy's probleMs.
sentences.zh: 辛迪问题的开端。

sentences.en: Roy makepeace believed that Cindy had multiple personality disorder, now known as dissociative identity disorder.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯认为辛迪患有多重人格障碍，现在称为解离性身份障碍。

sentences.en: He cited the trouble that Cindy had remembering events, the side of her personality that he described as childlike, and the trauma that Cindy had
sentences.zh: 他列举了辛迪难以记忆事件、她性格中被他描述为孩子气的一面，以及辛迪一生中

sentences.en: suffered in her life as pointing towards this diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 遭受的创伤，认为这些都指向了这种诊断。

sentences.en: Roy criticised the medical care that
sentences.zh: 罗伊批评了多年来

sentences.en: Cindy had been given over the years of the attacks.
sentences.zh: 辛迪在袭击期间所接受的医疗护理。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: There was no competent psychiatrist taking charge of her psychiatric treatment.
sentences.zh: 没有一位称职的精神科医生负责她的精神治疗。

sentences.en: I'm so resentful of the inadequacy of her psychiatric care.
sentences.zh: 我对她精神护理的不足感到非常愤慨。

sentences.en: Nobody checked the facts of her life, and that is tragic.
sentences.zh: 没有人核实她生活中的事实，这真是个悲剧。

sentences.en: It cost her her life.
sentences.zh: 这让她付出了生命的代价。

sentences.en: Roy believed that Cindy's use of the black nylon stocking to strangle herself might have had symbolic meaning, stemming from possible sexual abuse as a child.
sentences.zh: 罗伊认为，辛迪用黑色尼龙长筒袜勒死自己可能具有象征意义，源于她童年时期可能遭受的性虐待。

sentences.en: Cindy's brother gave evidence at the inquest denying he had ever sexually assaulted Cindy.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的兄弟在调查庭上作证，否认曾对辛迪进行过性侵犯。

sentences.en: The phone messages to Roy makepeace's answering machine were played.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·梅克皮斯电话答录机上的留言被播放了出来。

sentences.en: Richmond Constable Jerry Anderson believed it was the voice of Cindy
sentences.zh: 里士满警官杰里·安德森（Jerry Anderson）认为录音中的声音是辛迪·詹姆斯（Cindy

sentences.en: James on the recordings.
sentences.zh: James）的。

sentences.en: Others, including Roy makepeace and
sentences.zh: 其他人，包括罗伊·梅克皮斯和

sentences.en: Cindy's friends and family, believed that the messages were left by a male voice.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的亲友，则认为这些留言是一个男人的声音留下的。

sentences.en: Roy was at a loss to explain them.
sentences.zh: 罗伊对此感到束手无策，无法解释。

sentences.en: The Psycholinguistics Centre in New York analysed the messages.
sentences.zh: 纽约心理语言学中心对这些留言进行了分析。

sentences.en: The report found obvious similarities in voice characteristics between the recordings and audio of Cindy James's voice taken from a police interview.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，录音与警方采访辛迪·詹姆斯时留下的音频在语音特征上有明显的相似之处。

sentences.en: However, it reiterated that a positive identification could not be made because of the apparent disguise of the voice and the shortness of the messages.
sentences.zh: 然而，报告重申，由于声音明显经过伪装且留言过短，无法做出明确的鉴定。

sentences.en: The two men who approached Roy's door were never identified.
sentences.zh: 那两个接近罗伊家门的男人从未被查明身份。

sentences.en: However, the incident was believed to be unrelated to Cindy James.
sentences.zh: 不过，人们认为该事件与辛迪·詹姆斯无关。

sentences.en: The second part of the inquest focused on the day of Cindy's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 调查庭的第二部分重点关注了辛迪失踪的那一天。

sentences.en: Richmond detectives walked through
sentences.zh: 里士满探员重走了

sentences.en: Cindy's last known movements.
sentences.zh: 辛迪最后已知的活动轨迹。

sentences.en: They argued that Cindy had appeared so jubilant prior to her death because she had formulated a carefully orchestrated plan of her suicide and was going to carry it out.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，辛迪在去世前表现得如此兴高采烈，是因为她已经制定了一个精心策划的自杀计划，并准备付诸实施。

sentences.en: She went to the Blundell Road shopping centre, purchased bags of non-perishable foodstuffs and a birthday present for her friend's son.
sentences.zh: 她去了布伦德尔路（Blundell Road）购物中心，购买了几袋不易腐烂的食品和一份送给朋友儿子的生日礼物。

sentences.en: There was no receipt with the grocery bags.
sentences.zh: 购物袋里没有收据。

sentences.en: Detectives returned to the shop and ran the purchased items through the checkout.
sentences.zh: 探员们回到商店，在收银台核对了购买的商品。

sentences.en: None of the records for the day of Cindy's disappearance matched the dollar value of the groceries in Cindy's car.
sentences.zh: 当天的记录中，没有任何一笔交易与辛迪车内杂货的金额相符。

sentences.en: To detectives, it seemed as though
sentences.zh: 在探员看来，似乎

sentences.en: Cindy had also purchased a pair of stockings and other items and took them out of the bag before leaving the car park.
sentences.zh: 辛迪还购买了一双长筒袜和其他物品，并在离开停车场前把它们从袋子里拿了出来。

sentences.en: Lying under the car,
sentences.zh: 辛迪的银行卡和自动取款机收据似乎是被人

sentences.en: Cindy's bank card and ATM receipt appeared to have been placed there.
sentences.zh: 放在车下的。

sentences.en: They argued if it had been dropped in a struggle, the receipt would have separated from the card instead of being wrapped neatly around it.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，如果是在挣扎中掉落的，收据会与卡片分离，而不是整齐地包裹在卡片上。

sentences.en: Following the detectives' narrative, sometime after leaving the car park,
sentences.zh: 按照探员的叙述，在离开停车场后的某个时间，

sentences.en: Cindy consumed a large amount of florezepam and morphine tablets.
sentences.zh: 辛迪服用了大量的氟西泮（florezepam）和吗啡片。

sentences.en: She then had 20 minutes to get to the abandoned lot one and a half kilometres away before the drugs would have rendered her unconscious.
sentences.zh: 然后，她有20分钟的时间赶到一公里半外那片废弃的空地，之后药物就会让她失去知觉。

sentences.en: It was clear she had consumed the florezepam orally as residue of the drug was found in her stomach.
sentences.zh: 很明显她是口服了氟西泮，因为在她的胃里发现了药物残留。

sentences.en: To record the level found in her bloodstream, she would have had to have swallowed between 20 to 80 pills, depending on the concentration.
sentences.zh: 要达到血液中检测到的浓度，她必须吞下20到80片药，具体取决于浓度。

sentences.en: In addition, if Cindy also took the morphine orally, she would have had to have swallowed
sentences.zh: 此外，如果辛迪也是口服吗啡，她必须吞下

sentences.en: 18 tablets or 20 mils of a liquid preparation.
sentences.zh: 18片药片或20毫升的液体药剂。

sentences.en: It was assumed Cindy had taken the morphine orally as an intravenous injection would have rendered her incapacitated immediately.
sentences.zh: 人们推测辛迪是口服吗啡，因为静脉注射会让她立即失去行动能力。

sentences.en: This was despite the fact that a puncture mark from a needle was found on her right inner elbow.
sentences.zh: 尽管事实上在她的右肘内侧发现了一个针孔。

sentences.en: It could not be explained how Cindy had either of these drugs in her possession.
sentences.zh: 无法解释辛迪是如何获得这些药物的。

sentences.en: She was not prescribed florezepam or morphine.
sentences.zh: 她没有被开过氟西泮或吗啡的处方。

sentences.en: There were no missing drugs from the hospital where she worked.
sentences.zh: 她工作的医院也没有丢失这些药物。

sentences.en: Detectives theorised that the puncture mark on her right arm was caused by Cindy as she took blood from herself to smear on the door of her car.
sentences.zh: 探员们推测，她右臂上的针孔是辛迪自己造成的，因为她抽了自己的血涂在车门上。

sentences.en: However, Cindy was right-handed, meaning this would have been a difficult procedure for her to complete.
sentences.zh: 然而，辛迪是右撇子，这意味着这对她来说是一个很难完成的过程。

sentences.en: Detectives found it a plausible explanation that Cindy walked to the abandoned lot, laid down her coat, hogtied herself, and then lost consciousness, falling to her right side.
sentences.zh: 探员们认为这是一个合理的解释：辛迪走到废弃的空地，铺上外套，把自己捆绑起来，然后失去知觉，向右侧倒下。

sentences.en: This was evidenced by her blue coat found partially underneath her body.
sentences.zh: 她那件部分压在身下的蓝色外套就是证据。

sentences.en: To show the jury it was possible, knot tying expert Robert Chisnell took the same length and make of stocking found around Cindy's body.
sentences.zh: 为了向陪审团证明这是可能的，绳结专家罗伯特·奇斯内尔（Robert Chisnell）拿来了在辛迪尸体周围发现的同长度、同品牌的长筒袜。

sentences.en: He demonstrated how it was done, completing the complex tying procedure in about three minutes.
sentences.zh: 他演示了它是如何完成的，并在大约三分钟内完成了复杂的捆绑过程。

sentences.en: He said that the stocking, when found, was tied loosely enough around Cindy's wrists and ankles that it could be slipped on and off.
sentences.zh: 他说，长筒袜被发现时，系在辛迪手腕和脚踝上的松紧程度足以让人滑进滑出。

sentences.en: The hitches in the knots were also consistent with the unconventional way
sentences.zh: 绳结的扣法也与

sentences.en: Cindy knotted her shoelaces.
sentences.zh: 辛迪系鞋带的非传统方式一致。

sentences.en: Robert Chisnell believed that the knots in this case matched previous incidents with Cindy.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·奇斯内尔认为，本案中的绳结与辛迪之前的事件相吻合。

sentences.en: He also tied a black nylon stocking around his own neck in the same fashion, remarking that it was tight enough for him to feel lightheaded,
sentences.zh: 他还以同样的方式在自己的脖子上系了一条黑色尼龙长筒袜，并评论说，紧到让他感到头晕，

sentences.en: but not so tight that he would black out.
sentences.zh: 但还没紧到让他昏迷的地步。

sentences.en: Cindy's friends and family were outraged at this explanation, citing that there was no possible way that Cindy could have carried this out on her own.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的亲友对这一解释感到愤怒，称辛迪绝不可能独自完成这一切。

sentences.en: Surveillance on Cindy's home always resulted in the harassing phone calls and mail stopping.
sentences.zh: 对辛迪家的监控总是能让骚扰电话和邮件停止。

sentences.en: The few times that Cindy's friends or family had heard calls or seen people lurking around could not be explained.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的朋友或家人偶尔听到的电话或看到的人影都无法解释。

sentences.en: One detective accused them of covering up for her.
sentences.zh: 一名探员指责他们是在为她掩盖真相。

sentences.en: Cindy's former psychiatrist was of the impression that Cindy suffered from borderline personality disorder and post-traumatic stress disorder
sentences.zh: 辛迪的前任精神科医生认为，辛迪患有边缘性人格障碍和创伤后应激障碍，

sentences.en: stemming from unknown childhood trauma.
sentences.zh: 源于未知的童年创伤。

sentences.en: However, he argued it was difficult to diagnose and build rapport with her because she was such a guarded and private person.
sentences.zh: 然而，他认为很难对她进行诊断并与她建立融洽的关系，因为她是一个非常谨慎和内向的人。

sentences.en: Other diagnoses by psychiatrists who had examined Cindy over the years included anxiety, major depression, paranoid disorder, major affective disorder, psychotic delusions,
sentences.zh: 多年来为辛迪做过检查的精神科医生给出的其他诊断包括焦虑症、重度抑郁症、偏执型障碍、重度情感障碍、精神病性妄想，

sentences.en: and suicidal ideation.
sentences.zh: 以及自杀意念。

sentences.en: An excerpt from Cindy's journal written from St. Paul's psychiatric unit when she was receiving treatment three years prior to her death was read out.
sentences.zh: 会上宣读了辛迪在去世前三年于圣保罗精神科病房接受治疗时所写的一篇日记摘录。

sentences.en: I still feel suicide is my best option in an unbearable situation and as soon as I get out of here, I will carry out my plan.
sentences.zh: 我仍然觉得在无法忍受的情况下，自杀是我最好的选择，一旦我离开这里，我就会执行我的计划。

sentences.en: The majority of the public sympathised with Cindy, a woman who was let down in every way by systems that failed to protect her.
sentences.zh: 大多数公众同情辛迪，认为她被未能保护她的体制在各个方面所辜负。

sentences.en: Despite admissions to psychiatric units, she was repeatedly allowed to go home without receiving consistent treatment or diagnosis of her condition.
sentences.zh: 尽管曾被送入精神科病房，但她还是被反复允许回家，而没有得到持续的治疗或对其病情的诊断。

sentences.en: If it was that the attacks were occurring to her, the police failed to catch a perpetrator who terrorised Cindy for more than seven years.
sentences.zh: 如果袭击确实是针对她的，那么警方未能抓住那个恐吓了辛迪七年多的肇事者。

sentences.en: One forensic psychiatrist who reviewed Cindy's extensive medical history and police files told the inquest,
sentences.zh: 一位审阅了辛迪详尽病史和警方档案的法医精神科医生告诉调查庭：

sentences.en: The tragedy is that, with all these people involved, she wasn't saved.
sentences.zh: 悲剧在于，尽管有这么多人参与，她还是没能获救。

sentences.en: The inquest into the death of Cindy James was one of the most expensive and lengthy in British Columbia history.
sentences.zh: 对辛迪·詹姆斯死亡事件的调查是不列颠哥伦比亚省历史上最昂贵、最漫长的调查之一。

sentences.en: In the end, the jury failed to reach a conclusion as to whether Cindy had been murdered or had taken her own life.
sentences.zh: 最终，陪审团未能就辛迪是被谋杀还是自杀达成结论。

sentences.en: They determined that Cindy James died as the result of an unknown event after one vote shifted the decision from suicide to undetermined.
sentences.zh: 他们认定辛迪·詹姆斯死于一起不明事件，此前投票结果从自杀改为了原因不明。

sentences.en: Some thought that another person or persons were involved in the attacks orchestrated by Cindy.
sentences.zh: 有人认为，辛迪自导自演的袭击事件中还有其他人的参与。

sentences.en: Others proposed that Cindy knew much more about the identity of the perpetrator than she told authorities.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为，辛迪对肇事者的身份了解得比她告诉当局的要多得多。

sentences.en: One fact that was not argued by nearly all who knew Cindy was that if she had indeed carried out the attacks upon herself, she was not aware that she was doing so.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有认识辛迪的人都认同一点：如果这些袭击确实是她自己实施的，那她本人对此也并不知情。

sentences.en: The terror in her eyes, the very real emotion she portrayed during countless interviews, convinced nearly all involved that Cindy truly believed these attacks were occurring
sentences.zh: 她眼中的恐惧，以及她在无数次采访中流露出的真实情感，让所有相关人员都确信，辛迪是真的相信这些袭击

sentences.en: to her.
sentences.zh: 正在发生在她身上。

sentences.en: This lady suffered very deeply from within or out, one forensic psychiatrist stated.
sentences.zh: 一位法医精神病学家表示，这位女士无论是在内心还是外部都遭受了极大的痛苦。

sentences.en: He suggested that Cindy cast herself centre stage as the victim in a fantastic plot of her own creation, adding, she was in a living nightmare.
sentences.zh: 他认为辛迪将自己置于一场自创的离奇阴谋中，成为了舞台中央的受害者，并补充说，她生活在噩梦之中。

sentences.en: The coroner concluded,
sentences.zh: 验尸官总结道：

sentences.en: Cindy James was a victim, real or imagined, and lived in terror for an unknown period of time throughout her life.
sentences.zh: 辛迪·詹姆斯是一个受害者，无论这种受害是真实的还是想象的，她在生命中的一段未知时期里一直生活在恐惧之中。

sentences.en: The Hack family was devastated by the finding, hoping that the jury would recommend the case be reopened.
sentences.zh: 哈克一家对这一调查结果感到悲痛欲绝，他们希望陪审团能建议重启此案。

sentences.en: They vowed not to let their daughter's death go, determined to find her killer and bring them to justice.
sentences.zh: 他们发誓绝不让女儿的死就此了结，决心找到凶手并将他们绳之以法。

sentences.en: Sifting through the rubble of one of the fires that engulfed
sentences.zh: 在清理辛迪·詹姆斯地下室的一场火灾废墟时，

sentences.en: Cindy James' basement, authorities found a mauve-coloured notebook.
sentences.zh: 当局发现了一本淡紫色的笔记本。

sentences.en: It was Cindy's journal.
sentences.zh: 那是辛迪的日记本。

sentences.en: The hardcover was decorated with Cindy's favourite thing, blooms of coloured flowers.
sentences.zh: 硬皮封面上装饰着辛迪最喜欢的东西——盛开的彩色花朵。

sentences.en: Cindy's sister
sentences.zh: 辛迪的姐姐

sentences.en: Melanie had purchased the journal for her during her separation from Roy Makepeace.
sentences.zh: 梅兰妮是在辛迪与罗伊·梅克皮斯分居期间买给她的。

sentences.en: On the inside cover,
sentences.zh: 在封底内侧，

sentences.en: Melanie had inscribed a note and quote by naturalist
sentences.zh: 梅兰妮写下了一段寄语和博物学家

sentences.en: John Muir.
sentences.zh: 约翰·缪尔的一句名言。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: To my dear, sweet sister,
sentences.zh: 致我亲爱甜美的妹妹，

sentences.en: Cindy, It is always sunrise somewhere.
sentences.zh: 辛迪，无论何时，总有地方正迎来日出。

sentences.en: The dew is never all dried at once.
sentences.zh: 露水从未被一次性晒干。

sentences.en: A shower is forever falling.
sentences.zh: 阵雨永远在落下。

sentences.en: Vapour is forever rising.
sentences.zh: 水汽永远在升腾。

sentences.en: I hope that you feel the wonder of nature as I do.
sentences.zh: 希望你能像我一样感受到大自然的奇妙。

sentences.en: May it make you feel intensely alive and full of joy.
sentences.zh: 愿它让你感到生命力充沛，充满喜悦，

sentences.en: now and forever.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，直至永远。
